title: Bind reusable learning to execution-time evidence
summary: Reuse decisions need the executed revision, canonical receipt order and a governed review handoff; neither a valid schema nor an observation count proves successful reusable behavior.
reusable_steps: Reuse decisions need the executed revision, canonical receipt order and a governed review handoff; neither a valid schema nor an observation count proves successful reusable behavior
expected_outcome: When promoting an exploratory run, resolve its protected engine journal and verify completion, source digest and scope. Keep successful source execution separate from validation of the abstracted contract. Prefer improvements to existing assets, retain their base digest, and explicitly hand candidates into the existing steward review queue. Recheck source and target bindings at review and publication. Rebuild AI-DLC state from canonically ordered receipts and normalize declared inputs identically across CLI and worker paths before blocking unchanged failed contracts. Attribute knowledge outcomes only to the input actually executed or delivered; distinguish delivery, worker reports, independent success checks and unknown human intervention. Preserve references and later edits during maintenance or rollback. Run strict live-state tests separately from golden checks and mission bookkeeping, clean corrupt fixtures, and explicitly report incomplete telemetry instead of inventing success.
